newsitem.title: INDIA: India's GVK commissions turbine in Andhra Pradesh.
newsitem.headline: India's GVK commissions turbine in Andhra Pradesh.

text.p: GVK Industries Limited, the company developing India's first independent power project, announced on Friday that it had commissioned a third gas turbine at a plant in the southeast Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
The total installed capacity in phase one of the Jegurupadu project will be 235 megawatts, comprising three 52.8 mw gas turbines and a 77 mw steam turbine, a company press release said.
Phase one should be ready for commissioning in June 1997.
GVK has started planning and engineering work for phase two of the project, which is due to be completed by early 1999 and generate 220 mw.
The capital cost of phase one is estimated at 8.16 billion rupees ($228 million).
